manual_review.label: Visual layout
manual_review.why_manual: Automated checks cannot reliably judge clipping, spacing or visual balance across browsers.
manual_review.success_criteria: Cards fit their containers and no text is clipped at desktop and mobile widths.
manual_review.test_instruction: Open Mission Control and AI Recommendations; inspect at desktop width and a narrow mobile width.

manual_review.label: Recommendation clarity
manual_review.why_manual: Naturalness and usefulness of Danish wording require human judgement.
manual_review.success_criteria: The recommendation is understandable, honest about limited evidence and does not imply automatic action.
manual_review.test_instruction: Read the English-language recommendation and confirm the reason, limitation and actions are clear.

manual_review.label: Workflow usability
manual_review.why_manual: A browser smoke test can verify routing, but not whether the workflow feels intuitive.
manual_review.success_criteria: You can return to AI Workspace and understand the next action without explanation.
manual_review.test_instruction: Open Recommendations and Release Governance, then return to AI Workspace.

self_assessment.complexity_assessment: No new runtime framework; governance extends existing JSON + static dashboard pattern.
known_limitations: No analytics source is connected, so language recommendation confidence remains hypothesis-based.
